description: The flag is legal only STRICTLY inside an x-datacompany-hash-opaque subtree. Outside one it silently removes a member from the hash view with no recorded reason and no excluded_pointers entry, which is a second and reasonless spelling of x-datacompany-hash-excluded. Derivation refuses it.
expected_message_contains: x-datacompany-hash-declaration-only at ["/tags"] is not strictly inside an x-datacompany-hash-opaque subtree
